layout.confirmClear: Remove all stories from the pages?

layout.hint: Drag a story onto another to swap, or onto its edge to place it beside. Drag the thin lines between stories to resize.

layout.fillHint: How much of the page the stories need

preview.hint: A3 pages, exactly as printed. In the print dialog choose Save as PDF, paper size A3, margins None, scale 100%.
preview.empty: No stories on the pages yet. Use
preview.marksHint: Print a larger sheet (317 x 440 mm) with trim marks, a slug line, and 3 mm of bleed around each A3 page. In the print dialog choose that paper size or larger.

masthead.title: Masthead
masthead.name: Title (Telugu)
masthead.brandKitHint: New editions will start with this masthead

objects.noLayers: No objects yet. Insert text, a shape or an image.
objects.name: Name

masters.createHint: Move this page's objects onto a new master
masters.editing: Editing master: {{name}}. Changes appear on every page that uses it.
masters.confirmDelete: Delete this master? Pages that use it will stop showing it.

templates.title: Templates and brand
templates.intro: Save pages, whole editions, tile styles and your masthead once, and reuse them every day.
templates.pageHint: A page's tiles, styles and objects without its stories. Apply to any page; its stories are poured into the new slots.
templates.editionHint: All pages, masters and the masthead of an edition, without stories. Start tomorrow's edition from it.
templates.styleHint: Named styles for tiles. Save one from a tile's Style panel.
templates.brandHint: The masthead every new edition starts with.
templates.emptyPages: No page templates yet. On the Layout screen, press Save page as template.
templates.emptyEditions: No edition templates yet. On the Layout screen, press Save edition as template.
templates.emptyBrand: No brand kit yet. Edit the masthead on the Layout screen and press Save as brand kit.
templates.confirmUseEdition: Replace this edition's pages, masters and masthead with the template? Stories stay but become unplaced.

flow.title: Continue story
flow.hint: If the story does not fit, carry it on in another tile. Jump lines are added for you.

photos.name: Name

photos.confirmDelete: Delete this photo from the library?

adjust.title: Crop & adjust

preflight.allClear: No problems found. The pages are ready to print.

codes.emptyTile: A tile has no story or content.
codes.missingStory: A tile points to a story that no longer exists.

codes.photoMissing: A photo box has no picture.
codes.photoNotFound: A photo is missing from the library.
codes.lowResolution: A photo prints at {{ppi}} ppi, below the 200 ppi needed for a sharp print.
codes.offPage: An object is completely outside the page.
codes.shortOfBleed: An object reaches the page edge but stops short of the {{bleed}} mm bleed; a white sliver may show after trimming.
codes.fontMissing: The font {{family}} did not load; text would print in a different typeface.
codes.notApproved: A story is still {{status}}, not approved.

export.backupFailed: The backup could not be made.
export.restore: Restore edition from a backup file
export.noCompanion: One-click export needs the Tazza dev server with Chrome, Edge or Chromium installed. Use Print / Save as PDF instead.

workflow.readOnly: read only for your role now
workflow.noMoves: A {{role}} cannot move this story on from here.
workflow.confirmRestore: Replace the story text with this version? The current text is kept as a version.

sync.title: Share this edition
sync.intro: Run the Tazza sync server on one computer (pnpm sync-server), then enter its address and token on every computer that should share the same stories, pages and photos.
sync.conflicts: Changed on two computers at once; this computer's version was kept:

rail.title: Today's edition
rail.notYours: This step belongs to another role

newsroom.title: Newsroom
newsroom.subtitle: Every story in today's edition, and what each one needs next.
newsroom.empty: No stories yet. Write one, or load samples to see how the board works.
newsroom.waitingForPage_one: {{count}} approved story is not on a page yet.
newsroom.waitingForPage_other: {{count}} approved stories are not on a page yet.

hint.draft: Write freely. When it feels ready, send it to the editor.
hint.review: With the editor now. You will see comments here.
hint.approved: Approved. The designer can place it on a page.

home.badge: A newspaper studio for Telugu and English
home.heroText: One calm place where authors write, editors shape the day, and designers lay out A3 pages that print exactly as you see them. Telugu and English, side by side.
home.signInHint: No password needed. Pick your name and your role.
home.mockNote: This is a demo sign-in. Nothing leaves this computer.
home.howTitle: A day at the paper, in four steps
home.howText: Everyone sees the same rail at the top of the screen, so the whole team knows what is left before the press.

write.title: Write
write.text: Authors write in Telugu or English. The language is detected as they type, and a checklist says what is missing.

review.title: Review
review.text: Editors read, comment, send back or approve. Every change is saved as a version.

arrange.title: Arrange
arrange.text: Designers drop approved stories onto pages. Tazza suggests spacing and colour, and you accept what you like.

publish.title: Publish
publish.text: Preflight checks the pages, then one click makes a PDF or page images that match the screen.

home.rolesText: Pick the hat that fits your day. You can change it at any time from the menu at the top right.

reporter.title: Writes the stories
reporter.short: Write and send stories for review
reporter.p1: A distraction-free page to write on
reporter.p2: A checklist and word count that keep you on track
reporter.p3: Sends stories to the editor in one click

editor.title: Edits and runs the day
editor.p1: A board of every story by status
editor.p2: Approve, send back with a note, or reopen
editor.p3: Can write and arrange pages too

designer.title: Arranges the pages
designer.short: Lay out pages and prepare print
designer.p1: A calm page studio with suggestions
designer.p2: Colour coding and spacing in one click

home.helpTitle: Help that stays out of the way
home.helpText: Suggestions are plain rules a designer would use. They are always optional and one click to undo.

colour.title: Colour by section
colour.text: Sports, politics, business and more are recognised in English and Telugu and coloured to match.

spacing.title: Spacing that fits
spacing.text: Pages tell you when they are too full or too empty, and re-fit the columns for you.

language.title: Telugu and English together
language.text: Proper Telugu shaping on screen and in print, with the language detected as you write.

team.title: Works as a team
team.text: Comments, versions and roles, and sync between computers when you want it.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.text: Everything is stored on your computer first, so a bad connection never stops the day.

checks.title: Checks before print
checks.text: Missing photos, soft pictures, unapproved stories and fonts are caught before the press.

home.footer: Tazza · తాజా — made for daily newspapers

publish.title: Ready to publish?
publish.hint: Check the pages, then download them.
publish.marksNote: Adds a larger sheet with trim marks and 3 mm bleed.

advisor.title: Suggestions
advisor.allGood: Nothing to suggest. This page looks balanced.
advisor.note: Suggestions are simple newsroom rules. Nothing changes until you press a button, and Undo takes it back.
